title: PriorityHotbar
description: PriorityHotbar lets you customize the internal hotbar scan order. (marlows video)
body:
# 🎯 PriorityHotbar

> **Customize your hotbar's internal priority order — without moving a single item.**

---

## 📖 What is PriorityHotbar?

**PriorityHotbar** lets you customize Minecraft's internal hotbar priority 
order without moving your items visually.

Your hotbar stays exactly the same on screen — only the internal cooldown 
priority scan order is changed behind the scenes.

This is especially useful for **PvP loadouts** where you want specific 
weapons like a **Mace**, **Sword**, or **Axe** to be prioritized 
in a fully custom order.

---

## 🎥 Feature Explanation by Marlow

Marlow made a great video explaining exactly how this mod works and 
why it's useful in PvP situations:

[▶ Watch Marlow's Video on YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RVmQnDtNxKo)

---

## ✨ Features

- 🔢 **Custom Priority Order** – define exactly which hotbar slot gets priority
- 👁️ **Visual Hotbar Unchanged** – your items stay where they are on screen
- ⚔️ **PvP Optimized** – perfect for Mace, Sword, Axe priority setups
- ⚡ **Lightweight** – no performance impact
- 🔧 **Easy Config** – simple and clean setup
